# Pull Request

## Summary
<!-- What and why. Link the Issue this closes. -->

## Type
- [ ] `fix:` defect
- [ ] `feat:` new capability
- [ ] `docs:` documentation only
- [ ] `test:` tests only
- [ ] `chore:` maintenance

## Verification tiers (claim only what is true)
- [ ] 🟢 CI passes (GitHub Actions)
- [ ] 🟡 Functional self-test ran and passed (`python <module>.py --selftest`)
- [ ] 🔵 Expert review sign-off (rare — leave unchecked unless actually done)
- [ ] ⚪ Official source verified — cite source + version + date

> ⚠️ If any regulatory constant changed, list the official source + version + URL + verification date. Do NOT mark ⚪ unless traced.

## Scope check (maintainer will also verify)
- [ ] No change to medical-risk calculation or regulatory judgment for cosmetic reasons
- [ ] No license/IP change without prior approval
- [ ] Zero new external dependencies (unless repo allows)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main` and PR targets `main`

## Test plan
<!-- Commands run, expected vs actual. Screenshots/logs if helpful. -->
